subject: Site visit: medical advisory & contingency plan for GlobalBank exec workshops
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: j.singh@globalbank.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Site visit: medical advisory & contingency plan for GlobalBank exec workshops

Hi Jay and team,

Thanks again for inviting us to run the two-day executive workshops at GlobalBank HQ the week of Mar 9–10. Before we finalize travel logistics I want to confirm health and safety expectations and share a short contingency plan we can operate from if anything comes up on-site.

Attached: initial-risk-assessment.xlsx (summary of attendee risk factors) and proposed-contingency-checklist.docx (working checklist). Please review the items below and flag any questions.

Key asks from our side:
- Can you confirm the on-site emergency contact for GlobalBank (name/phone) and building security procedures?
- Are there any local travel advisories or health alerts for the downtown campus during those dates?
- Please confirm whether GlobalBank will provide a dedicated on-site safety lead or prefers Redwood to assign one.

Planned contingencies we propose (high level):
- Designate an on-site safety lead (Redwood or GlobalBank) who will be the escalation point for medical incidents.
- Publish a short attendee advisory with nearest clinic/hospital, EMT number, and building security desk info.
- Maintain a virtual backup plan (run workshops remotely) if travel is disrupted by severe weather or transit shutdowns.
- Contract MedEx (medevac) as a vendor for high-risk attendees; PulseTravel to manage travel rebooking.

I'll coordinate with Marcus on the vendor side and Steph on attendee communications. Laura will maintain the shared checklist and Drive folder.

Appreciate a quick confirmation so we can finalize travel insurance and vendor holds.

Best,

Hannah Schmitt
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
(415) 555-0191

Thanks everyone — this is perfect and appreciated. Quick confirmation of next steps:

- Steph will be the Redwood on-site safety lead and will share her mobile number with Priya. (Stephanie, please confirm by EOD Mon.)
- Marcus will finalize vendor holds for PulseTravel and MedEx. Marcus, please add the vendor PO/contract link to the Drive folder when available.
- Laura will share the Drive folder link and the attendee Emergency Quick Card template; GlobalBank can redline as needed.
- Jay — once you confirm Priya has Steph's number, we'll publish the attendee advisory and finalize travel insurance.

Contingency triggers we agreed to keep an eye on:
- City issues a travel ban OR airport closes for the event window -> move to fully virtual delivery and notify attendees 48+ hours in advance.
- Two or more staff/attendees report symptoms requiring medical attention -> activate on-site safety lead and engage MedEx.
